info.longBusinessSummary: Integrated Diagnostics Holdings plc, a consumer healthcare company, provides medical diagnostics services to patients. It offers approximately 3,000 diagnostic pathology tests, such as immunology, microbiology, haematology, endocrinology, clinical chemistry, molecular biology, parasitology, histopathology, and genetics. The company also provides radiology services, such as positron emission tomography - computed tomography (PET-CT), MRI, computed tomography (CT), mammography, ultrasound, X-Ray, electromyography, electroencephalography, electroencephalogram, and electrocardiogram, as well as operates cath lab facilities. It operates in Egypt, Sudan, Nigeria, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Saint Helier, Jersey.

rationale.growth: Years 1–2 from analyst consensus (2 analysts: 37.9%, 25.0%); then a straight-line fade to 2.5% terminal growth by year 7.
rationale.ebit_margin: Starts at last year's EBIT margin (29.6%) and moves to the 4-year median (27.6%) over 5 years.
rationale.tax: Median effective tax rate (30.0%), kept within 15–30%.
rationale.reinvestment: Historical medians: D&A 8.6%, capex 7.3% of revenue; working capital -6.2% of revenue, so each extra $1 of sales ties up $-0.06. Stock-based compensation (-0.1% of revenue) stays inside GAAP EBIT and is not added back, so it is treated as a real cost. IFRS reporters: lease payments sit in financing cash flow, so check capex covers them.
rationale.wacc: CAPM: risk-free 4.91% (US 10-year Treasury yield (CBOE ^TNX via Yahoo Finance)) + adjusted beta 0.65 × ERP 5.0% + small-cap premium 1.0% = cost of equity 9.15%. Pre-tax cost of debt 11.75% (interest ÷ debt). Market-value weights: debt 10.0%.
rationale.exit_multiple: Median peer EV/EBITDA (22.4x) as a cross-check terminal value.
